definitions.explanation: The introductory section at the beginning of a book, typically written by the author or another person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{序文|じょぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: A famous professor wrote the foreword.

examples.japanese: {序文|じょぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本文|ほんぶん}→本文：13064_honbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: I read the preface before proceeding to the main text.

examples.japanese: ⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{序文|じょぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動機|どうき}→動機：16028_douki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}っている→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: The author talks about the motivation for writing in the preface.

notes:
USAGE: {序文|じょぶん} is used for academic books, novels, and other written works.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {序文|じょぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write a preface)
- {序文|じょぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read the preface)

BOOK STRUCTURE TERMS:
- {序文|じょぶん} / ⟦まえがき→前書き：17127_maegaki⟧ - preface, foreword
- ⟦{目次|もくじ}→目次：00288_mokuji⟧ - table of contents
- ⟦{本文|ほんぶん}→本文：13064_honbun⟧ - main text
- ⟦{付録|ふろく}→付録：06206_furoku⟧ - appendix
- ⟦あとがき→あとがき：21507_atogaki⟧ - afterword

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦まえがき→前書き：17127_maegaki⟧ - preface (less formal than {序文|じょぶん})
- ⟦はじめに→はじめに：noentry⟧ - introduction (common in non-fiction)
- ⟦{緒言|しょげん}→緒言：29373_shogen⟧ - preface (formal, academic)
